title: Ideaboard scale plan and both P1 measurement reports
head: ea998fa0e9d83c1bd2822cd9c5eb9bda27d90d32

reviews.classification: historical scale plan with superseded premises and retained options
reviews.disposition: Preserve all S1–S13, P1–P8, R1–R11, Q1–Q4, user answers and LC1–LC13 as dated planning/authority history. The first-realm/prestige gate is retired, human acceptance is optional under AD42 and current LOTM/HP choices supersede the unanswered next-world/Skyrim proposal. Section 8 already rejects pausing runtime proposals; old worker/model defaults yield to current AU5/host rules. “Every idea somewhere” is explicitly linked to a proposal, so R1 must not promote it into accepted scope or deny the user’s broader ambition. A world’s different local mechanism can justify local code; no pack-only implementation mandate was accepted by Q4. Procedural/overlaid authoring, shared verbs and causal lazy detail remain useful candidates; nothing authorizes runtime text calls, source expansion, an agent fleet or a rewrite. Correct the obsolete “no loader” and “no generated journeys” priorities at their actual scope. Complete current world_pack_registry.js calls loadWorldPacks for MoL/HP/HP lead, exposes packNative and registers world_packs state/projection; the inspected book-beginning consumer reads packNative and registers HP lead/domain. The current registry also has optional per-life played/revealed state, so its older definition-only header is not its complete behavior. Current generator flags and B100/B101 receipts demonstrate selected world-parametric runners; they do not prove arbitrary world conversion or every signature loop. The single-target village rule resolver remains a narrower source limitation (B93). Counts of lines/files/worlds and mention-based unlock ranks are historical proxies, not current capability or cost measures. Read both P1 reports together. The first gate distinguishes low Node simulation-step cost from high browser busy/storage work and leaves whole tick unresolved. The later bounded 18-run matrix/profile qualifies that uncertainty: about 40/140/350 ms per game-minute browser script cost versus about 0.1/2.6/5.4 ms Node steps, with facts aggregation/panels a candidate hotspot. Those are different scopes, not a contradiction or a new run here. Three repeat gates, 18 matrix runs, noisy DOM/long tasks and limited profiles are separate measurements; viewport-insensitive at these sampled fixtures is not all layouts/input/paint. Repeated whole-save write volume is distinct from quota use and write latency. Synthetic 68 actors do not prove 128 actors, real late game or the actual away path; estimates for catch-up cannot settle its behavior. Guard usage must include the real envelope/backups/encoding, not the old raw-file size. Proposed performance budgets are not accepted gates and cannot be reset merely to pass. No Worker/Wasm/storage migration or benchmark rerun is selected by this reconciliation.
reviews.evidence: Complete original 402-line body read in four bounded ranges; original later P1/user-answer sections retained. Added front current-use pointer. Full current world_pack_registry.js, beginning consumer 1–37, generator options and resolver target inspected only for named absence claims.
reviews.reopen: Current queue selects a measured scaling consumer or specific contradiction; do not build the historical P1–P8 sequence or treat human acceptance as a hard stop.
